extensions.name: postgis
extensions.description: PostGIS adds support for geographic objects to the PostgreSQL database, allowing location queries to be run in SQL.

extensions.name: pg_cron
extensions.description: pg_cron is a simple cron-based job scheduler for PostgreSQL that runs inside the database as an extension.

extensions.name: pg_stat_statements
extensions.abstract: Track planning and execution statistics of all SQL statements executed
extensions.description: The pg_stat_statements module provides a means for tracking planning and execution statistics of all SQL statements executed by a server.

extensions.name: timescaledb_tsl
extensions.abstract: Enables scalable inserts and complex queries for time-series data (TSL licensed)
extensions.description: TimescaleDB TSL edition: time-series features under the Timescale License, including continuous aggregates and compression.

extensions.name: vector
extensions.abstract: Open-source vector similarity search for Postgres
extensions.description: pgvector provides vector data types and similarity search operators for embeddings stored in PostgreSQL.
